payload.title: Falsify or support distinct native-model and Clay workspaces
payload.work_clay: Build a research-only matched factorial on an activation-accessible open-weight surrogate first, and on the eventual Frank final model only when technically available. Factor A: NativeModelWorkspace intact vs lesion vs bounded steering. Factor B: ClayGWT truthful re-entry vs shuffled/provenance-broken vs no-reentry. Split complex reasoning tasks from fluent/automatic tasks. Freeze inputs/seeds and, where technically meaningful, freeze model output while architectural routing changes and freeze architecture while model-internal intervention changes. Measure task outcome, calibration, receiver delivery/reconstruction/use/local-effect, provenance-bound re-entry, recurrence depth, state/route diversity, overcoupling/instability, latency, tokens, CPU/GPU/RAM/VRAM and OOD transfer. LCOP readouts are evidence only and cannot grant truth, identity, effect authority or Harness mutation authority.
payload.reason_clay: Fresh AI-cognition research supports model-native workspace-like latent mechanisms in some models while Frank already has an explicit cross-organ Clay GWT. The highest-value unresolved question is whether these mechanisms are complementary, redundant, antagonistic or model-specific. A matched factorial can also falsify the new double-workspace-overcoupling hypothesis. Existing Frank loop/GWT measurement contracts already provide the necessary causal distinctions; no canonical architecture change is justified before this experiment.
payload.completion_clay: Produce raw matched rows and complete metadata; identify exact model/runtime/build/quantization and latent-basis versions; report NativeModelWorkspace measurement method and calibration; execute all declared factorial cells with repeated seeds; preserve failures/outliers; report outcome, receiver-use/re-entry, recurrence/diversity/instability and resource distributions; include additive/common-driver controls; classify whether native workspace and ClayGWT are COMPLEMENTARY, REDUNDANT, ANTAGONISTIC, MODEL_SPECIFIC_OR_UNRESOLVED; explicitly test double-workspace overcoupling; return SUPPORTED, REFUTED, REVISE or NO_CHANGE; do not promote LCOP/native latent control from observational evidence alone.
payload.executor_policy: Use a non-overlapping worker with repository checkout, local model/activation instrumentation and replay capability. Prefer an open-weight surrogate for method development; never infer unavailable final-model latent states. Refresh repo/head and active work before execution. Do not block higher-priority Frank v0.1 release blockers when the same scarce executor is required. No paid/final training. No Frank self-Harness authority.
invalidators: A newer owner-fixed directive forbids model-internal instrumentation or supersedes the LCOP research candidate
A newer independent experiment already executes the same native-workspace x ClayGWT matched factorial with adequate controls
The selected model exposes no technically valid activation/intervention surface and no suitable surrogate can test the method
A simpler baseline already proves NativeModelWorkspace measurement adds no material predictive or causal information under matched cost
